hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni’s corruption scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni faces escalating allegations of illicit enrichment and tax evasion after admitting to undeclared assets, including $500,000 in cash and cryptocurrencies. Opposition parties and allies demand his resignation, while judicial investigations expand.
hotspots.affect: This scandal commands disproportionate attention due to its moral outrage framing, polarized contention between government and opposition, and the high stakes for President Milei’s administration’s credibility.

hotspots.blurb: Hungary’s ruling Fidesz party faces internal turmoil after losing its two-thirds majority to the opposition Tisza party in April 2026. Tisza initiates sweeping reforms, including dismantling state media monopolies, firing intelligence chiefs, and negotiating minority rights deals with Ukraine, while Fidesz struggles to regroup.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to polarized contention over democratic backsliding, moral panic over corruption, and cross-source repetition of Tisza’s reformist agenda clashing with Fidesz’s legacy.
